palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a 105-character palindrome:

```
Madam Arora teaches malayalam
```

This short phrase is a palindrome when spaces and capitalization are ignored. If you include spaces and capitalization, it would be:

```
"A man a plan a canal Panama"
```

This famous phrase is also a palindrome.
